title: Mean preserved by monotonization
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$. The uniform mean of the real-valued function obtained by monotonizing $f$ equals the uniform mean of $f$, with its values viewed as real numbers.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the sign cube
